summary: Diageo plc filed a 6-K announcing Joanne Wilson will become Chief Financial Officer, joining the Board and Executive Committee sometime in 2027, replacing Nik Jhangiani. Wilson is currently CFO of WPP plc, with prior roles at Britvic, dunnhumby, Tesco and KPMG. Jhangiani, who joined in September 2024 and served as interim CEO from July to December 2025, will remain in role for a smooth handover. CEO Sir Dave Lewis and Chair Sir John Manzoni endorsed the transition; no Listing Rule 6.4.8 disclosures required. Watch the 2027 handover timeline and any further executive turnover.
